Overall visual target 8.5/10 is not reached: facade pattern repetition and oversized simple roof masses remain.
remainingWeaknesses: Far-window static isolation remains slightly above its limit; a development capture measured 0.167411%, but the final prescribed crop did not reproduce that pass and is the authoritative result.
Narrow repeated window/shadow patterns and flat baked glass gradients remain conspicuous in closeup and block.
Large stepped roof/crown masses remain blank or simply ribbed; added cladding alone does not make them convincing occupied/mechanical structures.
Shop lettering is readable and correctly oriented, but long fascias stretch the text and interior cards remain flat.
House roof/lawn material tiling and opaque boundary panels remain visibly procedural.
Secondary pass buffers increase allocated geometry: 1,612,174 triangle-equivalents in 104 meshes versus 1,100,412 logical main LOD triangles. Stats report main ranges, not total allocated buffers.
The prescribed all-module captures are an empty new game, so they verify ready integration but not the cost or appearance of a populated combined city.
Forced LOD1 loses facade relief strongly when applied to the entire skyline; mean image difference passes but the visual simplification is noticeable.

changesThisRound.change: Store full, LOD1 and shadow-only ranges within existing chunk meshes. Main pass uses original geometry; reflection uses LOD1, wide shadows use wall-shell geometry. Near shadows keep facade relief. Restore main draw ranges after each pass and keep logical LOD stats distinct from allocated buffers.
Emit wall shells for shadow-only LOD2. Apply ribbed metal to selected setback mechanical faces. Flip all retail sign quads to correct text orientation.
Increase far emissive mip bias and reduce emission beyond 200 m; near windows remain unchanged. Final crop still misses the static contrast limit.
Replace barcode-like sign rectangles with deterministic MARKET/CAFE/BOOKS/ATELIER canvas lettering while preserving RNG consumption.
